issues.description: Element: server POST handler for creating a Person. The problem statement (Part 1) instructs students to implement a method named `createPerson`, but both the provided client controller and the solution server implementation use the name `addPerson` for the POST handler. This name mismatch (createPerson vs. addPerson) can confuse students searching for the method to implement or reference in the template code and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement to refer to `addPerson` (preferred, since client and solution already use that name), or rename the server and client POST handler methods to `createPerson`. Ensure the UML, task descriptions, and any tests use the same name so students can reliably find and implement the intended endpoint.
